text:
if I had to explain to a 20-30 year old MM L/S equity analyst, what their goal should be by age 50-60:

I'll explain it the same way it was explained to me.

3 bullets

1. you want to be the #1 smartest person in the world on your sector.

2. you want industry CEO's/experts/strategists looking to YOU for insight on how the future will play out and how to manage their biz

3. at a multi-mgr L/S, you have billions of dollars in data + research budget. This is FAR more than any of these other guys have. So really, it should be an expectation that you know it better, and have better insight into the future

honestly, I would just simplify it as that you want to be the Gavin Baker of your industry.

100% of the opinions I've seen from people who matter -- for years --have all been the same..."he is that dude." 

that's where u want to get to.
